name: Cliopatria
attribution: Cliopatria: a geospatial dataset of worldwide polities from 3400 BCE to 2024 CE, Seshat Global History Databank, licensed CC BY 4.0. Boundaries reflect one version of historical territory and are approximate.
modifications: Filtered to the Ganga-Magadha-Eastern India corridor bbox [76.5, 19.8, 91.5, 31.5]; coordinates rounded to 4 decimal places (~11 m); integer years converted to EDTF under astronomical numbering; RELATION rows excluded from territorial assertions; no geometry was merged, smoothed or editorially altered.
